value.rationale: Complete TARGET census over the admitted scope 0<=n<=36 for a natural, pre-motivated object: misere Dawson's Kayles (octal 0.07), first cousin of Dawson's Chess whose misere analysis resisted solution for 70+ years. The exact singles P-set was not known or in any database, extends the prior partial frontiers (heap 24 Ferguson, heap 33 Plambeck-Siegel) with machine-checkable per-n certificates, and is the precise boundary datum a future researcher in misere octal games would need to retrieve. It is neither a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, nor unexplained enumeration.
